tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ع-ب-س (ʿ-b-s), 'to frown, be stern'; ʿAbbās also denotes a lion. Its root is ع-ب-س (ʿ-b-s). Borne by al-ʿAbbās ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, uncle of the Prophet ﷺ. Abbas is a Arabic name meaning “Lion; stern; frowning”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
